consent.alertText: Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) Notice: By accessing these learning materials, you acknowledge that your access activity (materials viewed, timestamps, device information) is logged for anti-sharing and security purposes. This data is processed in accordance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
antiSharingItems: Access is limited to registered devices only.
All materials are watermarked with your name and student ID.
Downloading, screenshotting, or sharing materials is strictly prohibited.
Violations may result in permanent account suspension.
rightsItems: Right to access your personal data held by ATRC.
Right to request correction of inaccurate data.
Right to erasure of your data upon request.
